title: Sum without the loop
prompt: Implement `sumTo(long n)`: return 1 + 2 + ... + n. A loop works for small n but the formula `n * (n + 1) / 2` works for any n — use it (watch: n * (n + 1) can overflow int, use long).

tests.name: large n
tests.hint: return n * (n + 1) / 2; with long arithmetic throughout.
